build_SparseSequential_model: build a SparseSequential container with SparseConv2d and ReLU layers for sparse tensor processing
create_SparseSequential_with_OrderedDict: create a SparseSequential model using an OrderedDict to name each sparse convolution and activation layer
use_ToDense_convert: use the ToDense module to convert a SparseConvTensor into an NCHW dense tensor
use_RemoveGrid_clear_buffer: use the RemoveGrid module to remove the pre-allocated grid buffer from a SparseConvTensor
fused_SparseSequential_bn: fuse SparseConvolution and BatchNorm1d layers in a SparseSequential using the fused method
